Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate criteria.
<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis we need a template that corresponds to the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction. In the forward direction a ketone and an alkene undergo a carbonyl‑ene reaction to give an allylic alcohol and a new C–C bond. Therefore, in the retrosynthetic direction we break the C–O bond of the alcohol back to a carbonyl, break the newly formed C–C bond, and regenerate the alkene. I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an alcohol and a C–C bond while forming a ketone and an alkene (i.e., the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene).
